tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Returns the current market exchange rate between two currencies as the number of units of to_currency per one unit of from_currency, with the time it was read. Use it to answer how much one currency is worth in another. It does not say whether Morse can send money in either currency; use list_send_d

tools.name: get_exchange_rate_history
tools.description: Returns how the market exchange rate between two currencies moved over the past week, month, 3 months or year, ending yesterday: the start and end rate as units of to_currency per one unit of from_currency, the change in absolute terms and percent, and the high, low and average. Use it to answer how

tools.name: get_story_status
tools.description: Says what happened to a request a Morse tool queued for the user, by its story_id: waiting for approval in the Morse app, executing, completed or failed, with one line to repeat to the user. Approved does not mean the money has arrived; repeat the line as given.

tools.name: list_send_destinations
tools.description: Returns the countries, currencies and payment rails a person living in from_country can send money to with Morse when paying someone else's bank account, with the typical delivery time for each. tools.name: quote_send
tools.description: Returns an indicative quote for sending money with Morse from a person living in from_country to someone else's bank account in to_country: the amount sent, the fee, the exchange rate, what the recipient gets, and the typical delivery time. total_cost is the fee plus the conversion spread included i

tools.name: send_p2p
tools.description: Asks the signed-in user to approve a payment to another Morse user. Use it when the user wants to send or pay money to someone on Morse.
